command: set +e; echo '=== top ==='; ls -la | head -80; echo '=== package ==='; for f in package.json pyproject.toml README.md VERSION .version .gitmodules; do if [ -f $f ]; then echo ---$f; head -120 $f; fi; done; echo '=== browse metadata ==='; for f in browse/package.json browse/README.md browse/build.ts browse/Makefile; do if [ -f $f ]; then echo ---$f; head -160 $f; fi; done; echo '=== source hints ==='; grep -RIl --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git -E 'github.com/.*/gstack|open-gstack|install.*gstack|npm.*gstack' . 2>/dev/null | head -40
